result.instructions: Tools for Conta, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customers still owe us money, and how much?"; "Show the profit and loss report for this year so far."; "List the invoices from last month that are still unpaid.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Conta data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run conta_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run conta_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run conta_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. conta_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: conta_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List the organizations (businesses) the API key's user can access, with their ids. Call this first to get the organizationId every other tool needs. Conta API: GET /invoice/organizations.

tools.name: conta_search_customers
tools.title: Search customers
tools.description: Search customers of an organization by free text (name, number, e-mail), or list them, with optional modified-date range. Conta API: GET /invoice/organizations/{organizationId}/customers.

q.description: Partial-word search across the main fields.

sort.description: Field name to sort by (not every field is sortable).

modifiedFromDate.description: Only customers modified on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

modifiedToDate.description: Only customers modified on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: conta_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Read one customer by id, including address, e-mail and invoice delivery settings. Conta API: GET /invoice/organizations/{organizationId}/customers/{customerId}.

tools.name: conta_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer in an organization. Writes live accounting data. Required: name, customerType (the code Conta expects), and the customer's street, postcode and city. Conta API: POST /invoice/organizations/{organizationId}/customers.

customerType.description: Customer type code, as the Conta API expects it.

customerAddressCountry.description: Country name or code, as Conta accepts it.

tools.name: conta_search_invoices
tools.title: Search invoices
tools.description: Search invoices of an organization with extra information. Filter by date range, customer, type or invoice number. Read only. Conta API: GET /invoice/organizations/{organizationId}/invoices.

q.description: Partial-word search across the main fields.

sort.description: Field name to sort by (not every field is sortable).

fromDate.description: Invoices dated on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

toDate.description: Invoices dated on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

type.description: Invoice type, as Conta names it.

tools.name: conta_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Read one invoice by id, with its lines, totals and payment status. Read only. Conta API: GET /invoice/organizations/{organizationId}/invoices/{invoiceId}.

tools.name: conta_get_unpaid_invoices
tools.title: Get unpaid invoices
tools.description: Return the three latest unpaid invoices with the key figures: total unpaid and overdue sums. Read only. Conta API: GET /invoice/organizations/{organizationId}/invoices/unpaid.

tools.name: conta_search_invoice_payments
tools.title: Search invoice payments
tools.description: Search payments recorded against invoices in an organization, with an optional date range. Read only. Conta API: GET /invoice/organizations/{organizationId}/invoice-payments.

q.description: Partial-word search across the main fields.

sort.description: Field name to sort by (not every field is sortable).

fromDate.description: Payments on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

toDate.description: Payments on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: conta_search_invoice_drafts
tools.title: Search invoice drafts
tools.description: List and search invoice drafts (not yet issued) in an organization. Read only. Conta API: GET /invoice/organizations/{organizationId}/invoice-drafts.

q.description: Partial-word search across the main fields.

sort.description: Field name to sort by (not every field is sortable).

fromDate.description: Drafts on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

toDate.description: Drafts on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: conta_search_products
tools.title: Search products
tools.description: Search products and services of an organization by free text, or list them. Read only. Conta API: GET /invoice/organizations/{organizationId}/products.

q.description: Partial-word search across the main fields.

sort.description: Field name to sort by (not every field is sortable).

fromDate.description: Products modified on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

toDate.description: Products modified on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: conta_list_bank_accounts
tools.title: List bank accounts
tools.description: List the bank accounts of an organization (IBAN, account number, name, invoicing use). Read only. Conta API: GET /invoice/organizations/{organizationId}/bank-accounts.

tools.name: conta_get_open_receivables
tools.title: Get open receivables
tools.description: Open accounts receivable for one customer or all customers, as of an optional period. Read only. Conta API: GET /accounting/organizations/{organizationId}/reports/accounts-receivable/open.

tools.name: conta_get_trial_balance
tools.title: Get trial balance
tools.description: Trial balance (saldobalanse) for an organization over a period, optionally limited to an account range. Read only. Conta API: GET /accounting/organizations/{organizationId}/reports/trial-balance.

startBookkeepingAccountNo.description: First account number in the range.

endBookkeepingAccountNo.description: Last account number in the range.

tools.name: conta_get_profit_and_loss
tools.title: Get profit and loss report
tools.description: Profit and loss report (resultatregnskap) for an organization over a period. Read only. Conta API: GET /accounting/organizations/{organizationId}/reports/profit-and-loss-report.

tools.name: conta_list_transactions

tools.description: List ledger transactions and their lines (bilag) for an organization over a period. Read only. Conta API: GET /accounting/organizations/{organizationId}/transactions2.
